utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to pin down the timing and drop-off spot before I commit. If Rey has those details, I can help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have the timing or drop-off spot yet, but I can check with the others and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that would help a lot. Just let me know the time and drop-off spot when you hear back, and I can plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s moving along nicely—still no confirmed drop-off time yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — just keep me posted when you hear the drop-off time, and I’ll spread the word and save a spot for anyone who wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep my ear out and pass it along as soon as I hear the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I can bring work gloves and help set up the tables. Just let me know any other details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Nell — thank you. I’ll pass along that we’ve got gloves and table help, and I’ll share any other repair drive details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. Just let me know when the details come in, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep the repair drive moving and let everyone know what’s next once Rosa gets the list together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll swing by late and check what we’re short on, then send the main list over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep everyone posted and repeat the plan once Rosa’s list is ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ve got the main repairs noted: the loose front steps, the broken fence gate, and a few leaky taps. It’s this Saturday morning at 9, and I’ll check what I can bring and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send me the list and keep me posted. I’ll see what I can help with on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the list and keep you posted. I’ll double-check what I can bring before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful — thank you, Kira. I’m sending out the Saturday repair-drive list now, and I’d love to know if there’s a small fix you want us to include.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Rosa — can you confirm the collection time and drop-off spot first? Then I’ll let you know if I’ve got a small fix to add.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — please drop everything at the community center by 9:00 a.m. on Saturday. If you have a small fix to add after that, I’d be glad to include it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still haven’t heard the exact spot, but I’ll check and send it as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Eli — appreciate it. Just send the spot when you’ve got it, and I’ll be ready with the tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do — I’ll keep it simple and send the spot as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — just let me know the pickup times, and I’ll work around them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll send you the pickup times as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — that works for me. I’ll stay flexible around the school schedule and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I think we should gather the broken stuff, label what needs fixing, and hand it off together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll help gather and label everything, and I’ll keep an eye out for the repair drive location too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — that’s a big help. I’ll keep sorting the parts, and if I remember anything else about the location, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira. Just let me know if you hear anything, and I’ll try to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — if I hear anything useful while I’m out, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — if you hear of any extra tools, tape, or batteries, send them my way. I’m keeping the list updated so we can spot what’s missing fast.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Cleo — I’ll pass along any extra tools, tape, or batteries I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — that helps a lot. I’ll keep updating the list, and if anything else runs low, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — I’ve got a wrench set and a hammer you can borrow. I’ll set them aside for the repair drive now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’ll swing by to pick them up and get them set with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Leo — I’ll keep them ready for you. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can keep the repair drive moving. Once Rosa has the list together, I’ll send it over and let everyone know what’s next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that would be a huge help. Once I’ve finished the list, I’ll send it your way so you can share the next steps with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Rosa — send it over when it’s ready, and I’ll pass along the next steps to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good—I’ll keep it simple and let you know as soon as I find the location.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — once you have the location, could you also send the collection time? I just want to make sure I’ve got the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course — I’ll send the location and collection time together as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. Send me the main list when you’re ready, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll send over the main list as soon as I’ve got it, and I’m happy to help set up too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I appreciate that—just send the list when you have it, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Kira — I think we should just gather the broken stuff, label what needs fixing, and hand it off together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the collection time and drop-off spot first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact time and spot—did we settle on those already? If not, let’s pin them down so I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need a few more hands to sort the donations. I can help organize if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be a big help, Leo — thanks. I can sort alongside you and keep an eye out for anything we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — let’s do that. I’ll start organizing the donations, and we can flag any missing items as we go.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll pass along that Mara’s gathering repair needs and volunteer offers, and folks should share what needs fixing so she can match people up. I’ll also keep Faye’s school pickup help in the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Rosa’s got the drive organized, Eli’s planning to get there early, and Oren’s handling the missing supplies. I’ll keep my ears open in case anything else turns up missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Ira — that’s really helpful. If you hear any other repair needs or volunteer offers, send them my way and I’ll pass them along to Mara.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I’ve got a wrench set and a hammer you can borrow. If you need anything else for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’s perfect. I’ll keep you posted if we need anything else, and please tell folks to send along any repair needs so I can match them up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Mara — I’ll pass that along and keep an ear out for any repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — I’m still tracking what we need, especially tools, tape, and spare batteries. If you spot anything running low, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I see anything low. Do you want me to ask around for a hammer, screwdriver, and duct tape too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please — that would be really helpful. A hammer, screwdriver, and duct tape would go right on the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t heard the exact location yet, but I’m keeping an eye out for it. If I find it, I’ll send it over right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Opal — that’d be great. I haven’t heard the exact spot yet either, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything turns up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’ll do the same and send you the repair drive location as soon as I hear where it’s headed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Vik. Just let me know what you need from me, and I’ll try to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep a spot open for you. Once I’ve got the details sorted, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll look out for your update and do my best to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll bring the tools and spare parts, and we can sort the donations together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Sam—just send me the pickup times and I’ll work around them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll send them over shortly, Faye, and I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m heading out now, so I’ll keep an ear out and check in if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll wait for your update. If you hear anything specific about what’s included, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll listen for anything specific and report back as soon as I can.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
